noun_definition: workspace option refers to a feature in the FAB menu that allows users to create a new workspace, which should remain visible and accessible even when the application is offline.
fab refers to the menu that appears automatically when creating a new account in the New dot app, which should provide options for workspace management.

offline mode refers to the state in which the application is not connected to the internet, affecting the visibility and availability of certain features, such as the New workspace option in the FAB menu.
